opennyai_summary.21_June_2023__facts:
Counsel appearing for applicant submitted that Section 409 of IPC is not mentioned in order.
On going through the bail application, which has been filed by applicant, it is found that Section 409 of IPC is not mentioned in bail application itself.
opennyai_summary.21_June_2023__decision:
Court has granted bail to applicant considering Sections 420, 406 of IPC and if offence under Section 409 of IPC is added, then the colour of criminal case and it's tenure will change completely.
In this circumstances, application (I.A.No.14144/2023) for modification of order dated 12.06.2023 cannot be allowed.
I.A.No.14144/2023 is dismissed.
Applicant is at liberty to file fresh application for grant of bail for offence under Section 409 of IPC.
